# Technology Innovation Institute

The Technology Innovation Institute (TII), a government laboratory founded in 2020, is the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. The organization describes itself as "a leading global scientific research center" dedicated to making "advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere." TII develops and open-sources generative AI models through its Falcon LLM family, positioning its work around efficiency, ethical design, and global scalability.

TII's flagship product is Falcon, a series of open-source large language models available under Apache 2.0 licensing. The Falcon family includes multiple variants: Falcon 180B, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens with 180 billion parameters and ranked at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open models; Falcon 40B, trained on one trillion tokens with 40 billion parameters; and Falcon 2 11B, which the company reports outperforms Meta's LLaMA 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B. The institute also offers Falcon-H1, built on a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture; Falcon H1R 7B, optimized for reasoning in mathematics and coding; Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model; Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities; and Falcon Arabic, developed for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects. TII established the non-profit Falcon Foundation to advance open-source generative AI development and build sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects, emphasizing Middle East data residency and sovereign AI infrastructure.
